info.title: Your-Reselling API
info.description: Registered public v1 routes, raw PHP attributes and statically extracted request validation. Response payloads are intentionally untyped where no authoritative schema exists.

Public, no API key needed, so it can be used directly in an tag. Returns the image itself (png, jpg or webp) with long-lived cache headers and an ETag (304 supported). post.description: Initiate a domain transfer from another registrar. "nameserver_mode" chooses what happens with the nameservers: "platform" (default) points the domain at our nameservers once the transfer completes, "external" keeps the nameservers of the previous provider (no zone is created here; switch later with POST {domain}/nameservers/platform). "dns_import" (only with "platform") takes the current DNS records of the old provider along: "scan" scans them for review, "apply" scans and writes them into our zone automatically. Default is "none".

get.description: Returns the state of the DNS import (scan of the previous provider's zone) and, once the scan is completed, the found records.

200.description: DNS import state. "status" is null (no import), pending, scanning, completed, failed or applied.

post.description: Scans the zone currently served by the previous provider (best effort, e.g. via AXFR or enumeration of common names). Only possible while the domain uses our nameservers (nameserver_mode "platform") and ideally before the transfer completes. With "auto_apply" the found records are written into our zone as soon as the scan is done; otherwise fetch them with GET and apply them with POST dns-import/apply.
Writes records of a completed scan into our DNS zone. Send "records" to apply an edited selection; without it all importable records of the scan are applied.
Create, update, or delete DNS records. Send the complete list of desired records.

language.description: Qwen Cloud models only: language of the text as ISO code (de, en, fr, es, it, pt, ru, ja, ko, zh, ar, th, vi, id, ms, fil). Optional; without it the language is detected from the text. Every voice reads every listed language. List them with GET /audio/voices?model=….

Supported formats, synchronous or asynchronous processing, and upload limits depend on the model; some models limit uploads to 25 MB.

file.description: Audio file to transcribe (up to 200 MB, model-specific limits apply)

post.description: Create a chat completion using an AI model. Supports SSE streaming via the stream parameter. Use model group slugs for automatic routing to the best available model.

message.content: Hello! How can I help you today?

messages.description: Array of message objects. For tool calling: assistant messages may have null content with tool_calls; tool messages require tool_call_id.

tools.description: List of tools (functions) the model may call. Each tool has type "function" and a function definition with name, description, and parameters (JSON Schema).

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool is called. "auto" (default), "none", "required", or {"type":"function","function":{"name":"…"}} to force a specific tool.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow the model to make multiple tool calls in parallel (default: true)

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

enable_thinking.description: Qwen Cloud models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM): turn reasoning ("thinking") on or off. Off answers directly and much faster (the Qwen 3.7 family otherwise reasons 10-20 seconds first) and saves the reasoning tokens, which are billed as output tokens. Default: the model's own default (on). While reasoning is on, the text arrives as "reasoning_content" (message and streamed deltas) before "content". glm-5.3, glm-5.3-prime and qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b always reason and answer HTTP 422 (thinking_cannot_be_disabled) when set to false.

thinking_budget.description: Qwen Cloud models: maximum number of reasoning tokens when thinking is on (limits latency and cost)

message.content: Based on the provided context, the answer is...

post.description: Starts an asynchronous video render and returns a video job object immediately. Poll `GET /videos/{video_id}` until `status` is `completed`, then download the MP4 from `GET /videos/{video_id}/content`. Billing uses the model catalog rates for the selected duration, resolution, audio and image inputs. The charge is booked once after completion.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio where supported; see model media constraints.

model.description: Video model slug or group slug, e.g. "sora-2"

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

seconds.description: Video duration in seconds. Sora: 4, 8 or 12 (default 8). Qwen Wan 3.0: 2-30, HappyHorse: 3-15.

size.description: Video resolution, e.g. "1280x720" (default) or "720x1280". Qwen models accept 854x480 / 1280x720 / 1920x1080 (and portrait or square variants); the resolution tier sets the price.

image_url.description: Optional HTTPS first-frame image URL where the model supports it

video_url.description: Video edit models only: public URL of the video to edit (the prompt describes the change). The output keeps the source length and is billed per output second.

reference_images.description: Reference image URLs for reference-to-video (max 9) and video edit (max 5) models

delete.description: Deletes the stored MP4 and cancels the render if it is still running. Usage already booked stays on your invoice.
